svg.title: MowEO architecture
svg.desc: CDSE openEO acquisition and preprocessing, downloaded NetCDF cubes, local mowing detection using private grassland masks, and spatial and temporal outputs.

g.text: MowEO
Automated Grassland Mowing Detection Using Sentinel-2 and openEO
Sentinel-2 / CDSE openEO
Cloud preprocessing
Local mowing detection
Spatial and temporal results
GeoTIFF / CSV / GeoPackage
AOI or country boundary, CRS, year and stable 5 km tile IDs
SENTINEL2_L2A; user account and credits
SCL dilation, NDVI (10 m), NDII and SWIRMean (20 m)
Annual NetCDF index cubes per 5 km tile
NDVI drop and regrowth; spatial and spectral support
User-owned detection and inner statistics masks
Detected event dates, mowing counts and diagnostics
Evidence scores are not calibrated probabilities
Pixel rasters, event tables and tile-level QA summaries
Raw / SEIVE counts, DOY 1-6, confidence and observation quality
DOWNLOAD / LOCAL STAGE BOUNDARY
One package: moweo acquire + moweo process, or moweo run --run
Private masks and reference observations are not distributed.
